text:
One room open in a beautiful 1920's three bedroom apartment near Larchmont & Hollywood starting anywhere between May 7th - May 15th!    (**Posting the room again since I ended up not being able to move out back in March**)

Monthly rent: $1056 plus shared utilities

The space: This is the top level of a classic duplex from the 1920s with tons of character –  hardwood throughout, cute light fixtures and colorful walls. The living room is pretty spacious with separate dining room, and one shared bathroom.

Your room: decently sized space with a walk-in closet! southeast facing windows that get amazing morning sunlight, especially in the winter months. 

Outside, there's an upstairs deck with a table and we converted the lower yard into a brick patio. We have a gated driveway with tandem parking but parking on the street is also consistently available.

Who you'd be living with:

Venetia is a queer teacher and writer! You'll often find her journaling to YouTube rain ambience, biking around the neighborhood, or dancing.

Carla is a longtime journalist now applying to grad school for social work.

Household vibe: we keep things pretty clean and uncluttered around here. Mostly we do our own thing but we like hosting movie/game nights sometimes and throw a couple house parties a year. We're both anticapitalist and would love if you were on the same page about that!

One bummer: We're allergic to cats and dogs, womp womp, so the apartment needs to be pet-free.

Next steps: We've created a Google Form with some questions. If you're interested, please fill it out and we'll reach out soon: https://forms.gle/znUPnw87V5sD9p4b9

text:
**SUBLET - Available May 1st: Fully furnished private room & private bathroom in spacious westside apartment with rooftop patio! 2-month sublease, then flexible month-to-month after that**

Looking for a roommate to share my top-floor, two-bedroom apartment in Del Rey! Conveniently located between Culver City, Mar Vista, and Marina del Rey. This spot includes your own parking space in a gated garage with 24/7 camera surveillance.

Common areas are fully furnished! The apartment is bright & airy, with vaulted ceilings, cozy furnishings, and a ton of natural light. The living area has two couches, a 65” TV with a bunch of streaming services, a gas fireplace, and lots of plants (we have very clean air in here!). The kitchen has a dishwasher, espresso machine, air fryer, toaster oven, and plenty of cabinet and fridge space. There’s a staircase leading to the private rooftop patio with an awesome green space filled with over 100 plants, cozy patio furniture, and gorgeous views of the Santa Monica Mountains, Marina del Rey, Westwood, and beyond.

**About the Bedroom & Bathroom**
- Unfurnished.
- Ample closet space (a full wall of 3 sliding doors). 
- Large window with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
- Clean laminate floors.
- Private attached bathroom with plenty of storage and a good-sized shower.

**Building Amenities**

- Laundry rooms on each floor ($2 per wash/dry).
- Elevator access.
- Gated parking garage.
- Located along the Culver Bike Path; bike to the beach in less than 20 minutes! 

**About Me**

I’m a 34-year-old environmental consultant working remotely. I’m usually home working during the weekdays (office space is in my bedroom), but often work elsewhere and still maintain an active lifestyle running, gardening, and traveling when I can. I don’t party or have company over often and strive to keep the place clean & organized, so it’s generally a peaceful, relaxing space. Ideally, I’m looking for someone who’s LGBTQ+ friendly, fully employed, and shares a similar appreciation for cleanliness and mutual respect for the shared areas.

**Rent**
The rate is $1,795 monthly, all-inclusive (covers rent, utilities, parking). The sublease agreement will be for 2 months beginning May 1st and then month-to-month after that. There is a $1,000 refundable security deposit, Total = $2,740 when you move in. Proof of income + a background check will be required. Move-in date: May 1st, 2026, but my current roommate may be leaving before then so there’s a chance the move-in date could be a few days before then. 

If this sounds like a good fit, send me a little bit about yourself and what you’re looking for, and we can set up a Zoom or FaceTime tour so you can see the place and we can chat!
